Package org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.model Description

Computation result data classes: each class name is unique to a computation so that automated data collection into ProcedureOutput subclasses can be performed without conflict. Subimage related data classes Subimage and SubimageDefList are included here as they play an integral part in computations.
